recognize_zh: 胸腰交界（T12）橫切面打顯影劑 T1 影像：椎體訊號不均勻，後方椎弓與棘突區有異常軟組織與強化並向椎管後側延伸，提示骨髓瘤侵犯後方結構並有硬膜外延伸。
features: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI at the thoracolumbar (T12) level
Heterogeneous marrow signal within the vertebral body
Abnormal enhancing tissue in the posterior elements and spinous process region
Soft tissue at the dorsal aspect of the spinal canal suggesting epidural extension
Subcutaneous fat remains bright, so fat suppression appears incomplete on this slice, limiting assessment of enhancement
describe_en: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI through the T12 level shows heterogeneous marrow signal in the vertebral body and abnormal enhancing tissue involving the posterior elements and spinous process, with soft tissue extending toward the dorsal spinal canal consistent with epidural extension. The subcutaneous fat remains bright, indicating incomplete fat suppression on this slice, which limits confident assessment of enhancement. Correlation with sagittal images and assessment for cord compression are needed. The findings are consistent with myelomatous involvement of the posterior elements with epidural extension.

ddx.vs: Metastases can look identical on MRI, so serum/urine M-protein studies and biopsy are required.
Solitary plasmacytoma is a single lesion with a clonal plasma cell-negative or minimal (<10%) marrow elsewhere, whereas this patient has diffuse multilevel marrow involvement.
Epidural abscess shows peripheral rim enhancement around a fluid collection, often with discitis, rather than solid enhancing tissue contiguous with infiltrated posterior elements.
